rule: cad_adapter stays frozen until the migration commit. Each defect: characterisation test = strict xfail on today's cad_adapter; replacement test = PASS on K1/K2. Remove an entry only in the commit that migrates or fixes it.

defects.summary: entities with the source invisibility flag are emitted as primitives (flag kept in provenance, read by no engine module)
content of a BLOCK_HEADER with an empty name is emitted at its block-local coordinates instead of through its INSERT
an OLE2FRAME the decoder labels with type code 2 disappears without any count (type 74 is counted)
an entity whose owner cannot be established is realised as model-space geometry (R8.1 K1 shared this; fixed in R8.2 Phase 0)
identity is keyed on the printed handle value; LibreDWG 0.13.3 prints 3-byte handles with 16 bits, so two entities can share one object_id
